songs.title: Sail Babylon Springs
songs.lyric: "And I reach for a glass of cool water drawn / From the rivers of Babylon"

songs.title: Going to Cleveland
songs.lyric: "I hear the Cuyahoga calling, now I know what I was born for"

songs.title: Andrew Eldritch is Moving Back to Leeds
songs.lyric: "Like a basket by the Nile hiding down among the reeds"

songs.title: New Britain
songs.lyric: "The sun climbs the sky for us above the Mississippi / And I can feel you in my arms, but you're hardly even with me"
